hero.title: SL Mini Golf Association
hero.supporting: Connecting players, celebrating talent and taking Indian mini golf further.

intro.heading: More than a game. One shared passion.
intro.body: An independent platform bringing India's mini-golf community together — connecting players, showcasing talent and telling the stories of the people who move the sport forward, from local greens to the international stage.
intro.short: Built on a love for mini golf: a home where players come together, journeys are shared and every achievement gets its moment.

visionMission.vision: A sport that grows beyond every boundary — where Indian talent is recognised and a connected community inspires the next generation of players.
visionMission.mission: To connect players, celebrate their wins, share their tournament journeys and grow the awareness and love of mini golf across India and beyond.

items.title: Players United
items.body: One passion, one community — mini-golf players brought together.

items.title: States Connected
items.body: Players and talent from across India, connected on one platform.

items.title: Achievements Celebrated
items.body: Every effort, every journey, every result — recognised and celebrated.

items.title: Beyond Boundaries
items.body: Taking Indian mini golf towards the recognition it deserves.
